clue.text: Stay true

clue.text: See 1
Many a bird that's black and yellow

explanation.definitionFit: A shindig is a noisy, lively party, the same thing as a knees-up.

clue.text: Offenders at first lie badly, worried in court

clue.text: Wearing clothes — that's said to be a pointer

clue.text: Decline to enter a dubious agreement

explanation.walkthrough: 'Decline' looks like the definition, but all four opening words are rearranged, with 'dubious' as the signal.
explanation.definitionFit: The Entente Cordiale was the 1904 understanding between Britain and France, a friendly diplomatic pact.

clue.text: Indian gangster

taken as written

clue.text: A horse was in front of Medical Man at first, but brought up the rear

indicators.note: at first places the medical man at the very start of the assembled word

explanation.definitionFit: To draggle is to trail behind or straggle, so one who draggled lagged at the back.

clue.text: Heated arguments heard in the belfry

clue.text: One creature about to become silent

indicators.note: about here means turned round, so the creature's name is read backwards

parts.note: a cat is a creature
the Roman numeral for one is I
to turn is to become, as milk turns sour

explanation.walkthrough: 'about' reverses CAT to make TAC, ahead of I and TURN; 'about to' looks like it means soon, but it splits.
explanation.definitionFit: A taciturn person says very little, reserved and uncommunicative by nature.

clue.text: Miranda in this met up, with somebody irritating

clue.text: Fawn, almost fully developed, browsed

clue.text: Tyrant has in store: the ultimate in unpleasantness

clue.text: Warm up detonator to explode an invention of Lewis 'Carroll

explanation.definitionFit: Humpty Dumpty explains blended words such as slithy and mimsy to Alice, the coinage being Carroll's own term.
